title: Saudian Lamb Kebabs with Italian Twist
description: A fusion of Italian and Saudian flavors, these lamb kebabs are marinated in a mixture of Italian herbs and spices, then grilled to perfection.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, rosemary, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Add lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with marinade.
Let lamb marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Grill lamb kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until cooked through.
Brush Italian dressing and pineapple juice onto lamb kebabs during the last 2 minutes of grilling.
Serve lamb kebabs with sliced red onion and red bell pepper.
